notes: מֵאָז split 'of' (מִן) + 'old' (אָז) under rule 2: each morpheme has an English word of its own, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet; a noncompositional 'of old' on the pair was the competing reading.
Second מִן takes 'art from' under rule 49 as the prepositional predicate of the verbless clause; אַתָּה keeps only 'Thou' under rule 20.
